name: Frame Timecode
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ function pad(s){s=""+s;return s.length<2?"0"+s:s;} var fps=env.fps>0?env.fps:30; var fr=Math.floor(env.frame); var ff=fr%Math.round(fps); var ts=Math.floor(fr/fps); el.text=pad(Math.floor(ts/3600))+":"+pad(Math.floor(ts/60)%60)+":"+pad(ts%60)+":"+pad(ff); return el; }
